about: 3.08 Vote Lab (Mandeep, 25 Nov 2026: the transcripts' best use, everything together). Every vote here is computed on every Trend Rider / Pro signal by live/provotes.py and recorded with the signal's Pro votes as x_<name> with weight 0: the score and the trades do not change. The Pro page's Checks tab and the nightly learned checks (3.07, 50+ signals each side, 0.25R edge, then judged on new days) grade them. 7 replayed days (claude/v2_fusion.md): only as_vwap2_stretch (used by Pro v2 as its no-chase check, rules/pro_v2.json) and gh_pause (a plus point in Pro v2's ranking) helped; the rest showed no edge or the opposite. A new book, video or course adds its votes here.

ema_stack_5_10.words: Price, 5 EMA and 10 EMA stacked the trade's way

ema10_pullback.words: 10 EMA pullback: a dip to the rising 10 EMA, then back with the trend

ema5_stretched.words: 5 EMA alert candle: the signal bar fully beyond the 5 EMA (stretched; the video's reversal sign)

gh_3touch.words: The broken level was touched 2+ times before (3 touches with the break)

gh_pause.words: A pause at the level before the break (2+ of the last 4 closes just below it)

gh_longrun.words: A long run into the level (1.5+ ATR in 3 bars): his 'skip after a long run'

gh_roundfig.words: A round figure just ahead (within 0.3 ATR)

gh_with_morning.words: With the day's move since the open (full size with the trend, half against)

gh_near_yclose.words: Too close to yesterday's close (within 0.3 ATR)

as_pivot_zone.words: Beyond R1 / S1 (2.2); between S1 and R1 = sideways

as_daily_sweep.words: Daily candle liquidity sweep: yesterday's low taken and back above (high for puts)

as_ema_9_21.words: EMA 9 above / below EMA 21 the trade's way (7.1)

as_rsi15_side.words: 15-minute RSI on the trade's side of 50 (double RSI, 2.6)

as_dow.words: Dow theory: higher highs and higher lows (lower for puts) (3.1)

as_vwap2_stretch.words: Already beyond VWAP +/- 2 sigma the trade's way (2.3 band): a late entry

as_retest.words: A retest of the broken level, not the first break (7.4 / James Berry)

cd_strong_body.words: Signal candle with a strong body (60%+ of its range) the trade's way

cd_wick_against.words: A long wick against the trade on the signal candle

cd_inside_break.words: An inside bar broken the trade's way
